precepts.text: Where no hedge is, there the possession is spoiled. If you do not lead your house, you lose control, and the possession is spoiled. If you are not there guiding, instructing, and correcting, the marriage comes to a crashing halt.
precepts.point: Slides read in class, things husbands do that destroy marriages: adultery and fornication, which has caused damage in Israel beyond repair, so if you are battling that, get help right now; failure to lead; bitterness and harshness, holding things over her head after she has repented, humiliating her, unrealistic expectations; neglect, when a trip to the store is the only outing your wife has had in months, take your wife out, because ordering the house and dealing with the kids is difficult; pride and refusing correction, you ask leadership for counsel, then leave and remix it your own way; financial irresponsibility, wasting money, gambling, hiding spending, chasing image over stability; lack of self control, emotional men punching walls and threatening divorce constantly, saying things that cannot be unsaid; loving the world more than his family, idolizing jobs, status, and friends; failure to dwell with his wife according to knowledge; and withholding love and affection, because if she is not getting it from you, where is she going to get it from?

note.label: Agree Together | Bound Not Bondage

precepts.why:
“Where no hedge is, there the possession is spoiled.” A bishop must be “One that ruleth well his own house”, and a man who will not lead his house has no hedge around it. If you don’t lead your house, you are going to lose control, and your possession, your wife, will be spoiled.

Failure to lead is one of the things husbands do that destroy marriages. Not stepping up, not taking control of your home, being a passive individual while your wife walks all over you. Eventually some other man is going to come along who catches her eye, and she is going to desire and look to him. Coach Dingolane destroyed a house that way, all because a man would not step up and lead his home.

The flock of God’s pasture are men, and leaders are men. If you are not there guiding, not there instructing, not there correcting, the marriage will come to a crashing halt with her standing over you.

That is why Paul asks, “For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?” How can you lead other men and tell them this is the way, if your own house is out of order, if your wife doesn’t listen to you and your kids don’t listen to you? You cannot be over men if you are not able to rule your own house. And the qualities of a bishop are for every man: a bishop is an example of what we are all supposed to be.

precepts.text: The belly devoureth all meats, yet is one meat better than another: as the palate tasteth divers kinds of venison, so doth an heart of understanding false speeches. The same way your palate can taste which meat is better, a heart of understanding can discern false speech the moment it starts. Multitude of words does not cover it; a man of understanding hears the murmuring underneath.
precepts.point: For she is the breath of the power of God, and a pure influence flowing from the glory of the Almighty. That is the breath that was breathed into us in Genesis 2. If those are the attributes of wisdom, you want to be tethered to wisdom, so you can discern, so you understand why people do the things they do, so you know the intents of a person's heart when they speak.

note.label: Listen, Learn & Live The Art of Enduring in The Truth

precepts.why:
“The belly devoureth all meats, yet is one meat better than another.” Why is one meat better than another? Because you can taste it. You have a palate, and you can say, I like this one better than that one.

“As the palate tasteth divers kinds of venison: so doth an heart of understanding false speeches.” The same way your palate can taste which meat is better, a heart of understanding can discern false speech. You listen to somebody and you know: this is BS. It happened recently, around Passover, talking to a brother: listening for a while, it didn't add up, it started to sound like murmuring. You would have been better off keeping quiet, but being that you want to talk, go ahead and embarrass yourself.

That is what Wisdom of Solomon 7 is describing. Wisdom is “Kind to man, steadfast, sure, free from care, having all power, overseeing all things, and going through all understanding, pure, and most subtil, spirits.” If those are the attributes of wisdom, you want to be tethered to wisdom, so you can discern and understand why people do the things they do: the defense mechanism, the gaslighting, the one in error trying to tug on your heart and make you feel guilty so you will chase him. That's not how this goes. He is supposed to wear down the footsteps.

precepts.text: He that getteth a wife beginneth a possession, a help like unto himself, and a pillar of rest. Partnership and support, stability and wisdom over emotional intensity, which comes as a byproduct.
precepts.point: He took her uprightly and they aged together mercifully, and with age comes beauty, love, and passion, not whimsical movie feelings. Stop chasing a feeling; get your mind like Tobit's. If even a majority of families moved in that spirit, how much stronger are we as a people for the time of trouble to come. Weddings are not done here for anyone who has not proved for three years.

note.label: Marriage Beyond Romance: From Eden to Modern Confusion

precepts.why:
Tobias prayed, “Thou madest Adam, and gavest him Eve his wife for an helper and stay”, and “let us make unto him an aid like unto himself.” Sirach says the same: “He that getteth a wife beginneth a possession, a help like unto himself, and a pillar of rest.”

Marriage describes partnership and support, plain and simple. Not a rom-com romantic movie, not a novella or a soap opera. A help like unto himself, a pillar of rest.

What do you see in those words? Stability and wisdom over emotional intensity. We have to stop emphasizing the wrong thing. The emotional intensity comes as a byproduct of those things.

The Bible shows men taking wives: he took a wife, he got a possession. That is the foundation Tobias laid in his prayer, a helper and stay from whom came mankind, a nation, and it is what we must get back to.

precepts.text: Make the time short, remember the covenant, and let them declare thy wonderful works. We say it, but we are not on the Lord's level; he will not be a millisecond late. In the meantime be in the right spiritual space so the day does not catch you as a thief. Examine yourselves, and examine your brothers and sisters; the ones who say they can fellowship at home do not want anyone to see their evil, and the wounds of a friend are better than the kisses of an enemy.
precepts.point: The sea is the navy and the battleships; the trees burn when the fire comes; it is the same scene as 2 Esdras 13:5, the multitude gathered from the four winds to subdue the man from the sea. The nations will try to fight Christ to keep us in slavery, and he is coming to destroy every one of them, and us too if we are not right.

note.label: The Vantage Point of the Elders: the Fathers Have Spoken

precepts.why:
Here is another thing we say: make the time short, “remember the covenant, and let them declare thy wonderful works.” Lord, make the time short; remember the covenant you made with us; let the nations know you love us, tear these nations up and set us on high.

But you are not on the Lord’s level. Believe me, the Lord will not be a millisecond late when it comes to sending his angels in to destroy our enemies, and you do not know that time. So in our wanting it, what should we be doing? Making sure we are in the right spiritual and mental space, so that when he sends the angels we are not caught off guard as by a thief in the night. We want to declare his wonderful works with a hundred percent confidence, not nervous that we are still in sin somewhere that has not been found out yet.

That is why the Bible says examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith. Congregations have to examine themselves; examine your brothers and your sisters. The people who say, I don’t need to congregate, I can fellowship at home, say it because they don’t want anybody to see their nasty, wicked evil. When you come in here it is going to show, and righteous brothers and sisters are going to point it out.

Accept that correction, because it is love: the wounds of a friend rather than the kisses of an enemy. Somebody telling you where it is at will keep you out of trouble and set you right for when the Lord does send the angels. The angels are holding the four winds until the servants of God are sealed; make sure you are one of them when the time is made short.

precepts.text: Fill Zion with thine unspeakable oracles; give testimony unto those that thou hast possessed from the beginning.
precepts.point: Let them bring forth their witnesses; ye are my witnesses, saith the Lord. Israel, the stick of Judah and the stick of Ephraim, are his witnesses.

note.label: Judgement - the Testimony of the Two Witnesses

precepts.why:
“Ye are my witnesses, saith the Lord.” A witness has a testimony. What is the testimony Israel carries? Sirach shows where it came from: “Fill Sion with thine unspeakable oracles, and thy people with thy glory: Give testimony unto those that thou hast possessed from the beginning, and raise up prophets that have been in thy name.”

The testimonies are what God gave to Moses, to Jeremiah, to Nahum, to Micah, to Isaiah, to Peter, Paul and the apostles. All the things these men wrote are the testimony: testimonies of things that are going to happen in the future, of what is going to happen to the children of Israel.

So when the scripture says the witnesses have to testify, the testimony is what is written, what the prophets said is going to happen. That is why Isaiah 43:9 asks “who among them can declare this, and shew us former things?” No other nation can. Israel, the people God possessed from the beginning, was given the unspeakable oracles, and we testify them.

And as we testify, we bring forth judgment. Brought before governors and kings “for a testimony against them and the Gentiles”, it is not we who speak but the Spirit of our Father speaking in us. The wicked who hides as an angel of light is revealed and condemned, because the witnesses must testify first before God brings forth judgment, as in a court of law.

precepts.text: If there be kindness, meekness and comfort in her tongue, her husband is not like other men.
precepts.point: Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him lord.

note.label: Transforming from Immorality into Beautiful Civility Part 2

precepts.why:
“Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel.” It is not saying a woman can’t have the outward adorning. Some think a woman has to look bummy and can’t get dressed up. Sisters can plait their heads and get fixed up; just don’t let your glory be in that, because a woman can be all hooked up and her spirit rotten. “But let it be the hidden man of the heart”, meaning Christ is in her spirit, “even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.”

What that hidden adorning sounds like, Sirach tells: “If there be kindness, meekness, and comfort, in her tongue, then is not her husband like other men.” A man who has a woman like this is not like most men, who don’t have it. That shows how rare this spirit is. Some brothers hear that verse and melt, because they don’t have it: do women like this even exist? Ask a sister and she can name twenty things she doesn’t like about her husband, but has to rack her brain for one or two good things.

Meek means obedience. Not always screaming, arguing and fighting, when the man just got through dealing with all that in the street and is the one making sure you have a house over your head and heat; you are biting the hand that feeds you. “For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord.” She adorned herself with subjection to her husband, and that is of great price, far above rubies. Not my lord on the phone with the sisters and cursing him as soon as the phone hangs up.

Beauty is corruptible, the clothes are corruptible; those things fade. A righteous spirit stays with you, and that is how you grow old in righteousness together watching the grandkids. Your inner spirit makes your outside look good. When you find a woman with kindness, meekness and comfort in her tongue, you will have paradise in your marriage and not a prison marriage, because husband and wife is the beginning, the nucleus of everything.

precepts.text: Smite the heads of the rulers of the heathen, and gather all the tribes of Jacob together.
precepts.point: After Adam transgressed, the ways became narrow, and Israel must now labour for the inheritance.

note.label: The Kingdom Of Adam And The Old World

precepts.why:
“Smite in sunder the heads of the rulers of the heathen, that say, There is none other but we. Gather all the tribes of Jacob together, and inherit thou them, as from the beginning.” As from the beginning: so the tribes of Jacob were with the Lord in the beginning, in Genesis.

In Genesis the sons of God were there. When Adam fell, the sons of God were there. There was a government set up, rulership, a kingdom set up with Adam; Adam was not running around naked. There were the gates of Levi, the gates of Benjamin, the gates of Manasses: all twelve tribes in the beginning with the Lord, in their spiritual bodies. People ask what tribe Abraham was from, what tribe Isaac was from. The twelve tribes were always there. When Moses says the sons of God, that is the twelve tribes.

“O Lord, have mercy upon the people that is called by thy name, and upon Israel, whom thou hast named thy firstborn.” We are named God's firstborn because he created us first, before the world began. “O be merciful unto Jerusalem, thy holy city, the place of thy rest”, and “Give testimony unto those that thou hast possessed from the beginning, and raise up prophets that have been in thy name.”

In these last days God has raised up the prophets that have been in his name. The prophets of old are back, in the tribes of Israel, in this building.

precepts.text: A man loveth nothing better than the beauty of a woman; that is what Jacob saw in Rachel.
precepts.point: Do not be hasty to credit somebody based on their looks. Of course you want somebody you are attracted to, but commending a person for beauty alone gets a lot of people in trouble.

note.label: Genesis 29: Bone and Flesh in Haran

precepts.why:
“The beauty of a woman cheereth the countenance, and a man loveth nothing better.” That is what Jacob saw in Rachel. Leah “was tender eyed; but Rachel was beautiful and well favoured. And Jacob loved Rachel”, and his eyes had been fixed on her from the start: he ran to roll the stone from the well's mouth, watered her flock and kissed her when she came out with the sheep, and now he offers to serve seven years for her.

There is nothing strange in that. A man loveth nothing better than the beauty of a woman, and of course you want somebody you are attracted to. The scripture simply names what moved Jacob.

precepts.text: Where no hedge is, the possession is spoiled; the covering of the house is the hedge.
precepts.point: The husband is a hedge of protection; where no hedge is, the possession is spoiled. The married woman has a covering that the widow and the divorced woman do not have.

note.label: Numbers 30: The Law of Vows

precepts.why:
“But every vow of a widow, and of her that is divorced, wherewith they have bound their souls, shall stand against her.” She has no father or husband to disallow it, so what she vows she must perform.

“Where no hedge is, there the possession is spoiled: and he that hath no wife will wander up and down mourning.” The husband is a hedge of protection, the covering of the house. The married woman has a covering that the widow and the divorced woman do not have; where that hedge is gone, nothing stands between her and the vow she bound on her soul.

precepts.point: The Most High controls the rain, the insects, and the pestilence. The people called by His name are Israel, the same people read through these chapters, and healing follows their humbling and turning, not a general love for all nations.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 7: Fire From Heaven and the Terms of the Covenant

precepts.why:
“O Lord, have mercy upon the people that is called by thy name, and upon Israel, whom thou hast named thy firstborn.”

The people called by his name is Israel, his firstborn. That is who the Most High speaks to when he says, “If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.” The mercy and the healing are promised to Israel, not to all nations.

precepts.text: Send thy fear upon the nations, destroy the adversary, and let them perish that oppress the people, that all may know there is no God but only thou.
precepts.point: The Lord of hosts is with us and the God of Jacob is our refuge. When Christ comes back He lays war down; everyone else goes into bondage and we rule.

note.label: Psalm 46: God Is Our Refuge and Maketh Wars to Cease

precepts.why:
“Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.” Ecclesiasticus 36 is the prayer for that exalting: “Have mercy upon us, O Lord God of all, and behold us: And send thy fear upon all the nations that seek not after thee. Lift up thy hand against the strange nations, and let them see thy power.” “And let them know thee, as we have known thee, that there is no God but only thou, O God.”

The prayer asks for the destruction of the oppressor: “Raise up indignation, and pour out wrath: take away the adversary, and destroy the enemy.” “Let him that escapeth be consumed by the rage of the fire; and let them perish that oppress the people. Smite in sunder the heads of the rulers of the heathen, that say, There is none other but we.” And for Israel: “Gather all the tribes of Jacob together, and inherit thou them, as from the beginning. O Lord, have mercy upon the people that is called by thy name, and upon Israel, whom thou hast named thy firstborn.” It ends with the reason: “that all they which dwell upon the earth may know that thou art the Lord, the eternal God.”

That is how the Most High is exalted among the heathen and in the earth. When Christ comes back he lays war down; everyone else goes into bondage and we rule, the tribes of Jacob gathered and inherited as from the beginning. “The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge.”

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 8 A Star Called Wormwood

precepts.why: Make the time short. Christ said the same thing: “And except those days should be shortened,” He is going to shorten the time. “there should no flesh be saved:” Because if you don't shorten the time, everybody would die, all of Israel; that is what he is talking about. “but for the elect’s sake” That is the proof that it is Israel: we are the elect. “those days shall be shortened.” The days shall be shortened.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 8 A Star Called Wormwood

precepts.why: “But this I say, brethren, the time is short:” You were wondering why we went here, ain't that talking about women? The time is short, brothers. “it remaineth, that both they that have wives” That's you married men. “be as though they had none;” Meaning what? Put God first. That is all it is saying. It doesn't mean drop your wife like a bad habit; it means put God first, and that is something black men have a hard time doing, with all them damn Keith Sweat songs. Millennials, who is the latest crying Negro out there crying for women? All this crying for women has to stop; the Most High is going to make this thing stop. You brothers are going to stop running around kissing a woman's behind. That is what Paul is saying. Which would you rather have when the Lord returns: you out doing the work, or you huddled under your woman's skirt, oh baby, I love you? Here comes the Lord and you ain't doing his work, you are doing her work. What is my servant doing?

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 8 A Star Called Wormwood

precepts.why:
Some of us know and believe the end is coming. Some of us are just hoping the end is coming. And some are just here in unbelief abiding: abiding time for a job, or a spouse, whichever comes first, and then we will never see you again, and God won't see you any more either. The ones that are only here for a spouse are the ones that can't wait for the proving process, six months to a year; they do the back-door marriage. Oh, that IUIC camp has some pretty women in there; oh, they have some handsome dudes in there; then bang bang, and they are out in the world again. Some of them used to sit right here; now they went to another camp and got another man, measuring tape and all.

“When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus. And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi,” Rabbi means master. “when camest thou hither? Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you,” Listen good to what Christ says to these people that were looking so desperately for him, like they believed. “Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.” Christ cut them sharp: some of you only seek me not because of the miracles but because you got food; you got fed, and that is why you follow me. Believe it or not, some of us listening right now, in here or online, are only following because there is some benefit you are looking for, whether it be food, a job or a spouse. One of those three things.

“Labour not for the meat which perisheth,” Labour means to work; don't work and strive for the meat that perishes. “but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life,” The meat that endures unto everlasting life is the word of God, the commandments. “which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.” Some people, men and women, will only love you as much as they can use you; their loyalty ends where the benefits stop. There has been a slew of people who say the Quest was good, I'm going on the Quest, and they spend their rent money, and when they come back from the Quest, can you give me my rent money, I need help. That means you should not have gone on the Quest, because you were not prepared to go. Or they ask for the rent money before, and then go on the Quest after. It is like a pattern we see, and don't think we are simple, we see it, and the Lord sees that too.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 8 A Star Called Wormwood

precepts.why:
Some people are only here for what benefit they can suck out of this truth, and it is never a righteous thing they are looking for. “For yet a little while, and he that shall come will come, and will not tarry.” Paul is reminding the Israelites, the Hebrews: he will not wait long. “Now the just shall live by faith:” You brothers and sisters, the just, those of you that are in here sincerely in this truth, live by faith. “but if any man draw back,” If any of you draw back, you decide, you know what, I'm going back out into the world, or I'm going to separate and do my own thing and curse the brothers and sisters that taught me: that is drawing back; you are not in the truth. “my soul shall have no pleasure in him.” You ever notice the spirits that draw back all of a sudden get revelations of great wisdom? I drew back from you all, I don't believe what you all believe, but God has now endowed me with wisdom: this is when the days begin, this is when the Sabbath begins. It is a pattern; it is the same thing from decades past, so it is no shock any more. It is like the same demon that jumps on people and says, now you have the wisdom, go ahead and do your thing: the days are wrong, and I have the wisdom and you don't. It is the same spirit. And they all say they are not drawing back, they are still in the truth, with all the evil. The scripture says if you have hatred in your heart for your brother you are a murderer, and no murderer has eternal life abiding in him. So you call the police on a brother, get him locked up unlawfully, get his furniture taken, his kids sleeping on the floor, even try to get his kids thrown out, then get on YouTube and Facebook and say I'm still in the truth? What scripture allows that? The god they are following is called Beelzebub, Satan, Lord of the Flies. But they are still in the truth.

“But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition;” We are not of them who draw back unto hell; that is what perdition means, hell. You leave this truth, you have drawn back unto hell. “but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.” That is what we are: we believe unto the saving of the soul.

points: “And send thy fear upon all the nations that seek not after thee. Lift up thy hand against the strange nations, and let them see thy power.” Sirach is asking the Lord to lift up his hand against the strange nations; these are the non-Israelite nations.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 8 A Star Called Wormwood

points: “As thou wast sanctified in us before them: so be thou magnified among them before us.” Because he is going to smite these down, every last one of them, like it says in Daniel 7:9. “And let them know thee, as we have known thee, that there is no God but only thou, O God.” The whole world is going to know that there is only one God, that's it, and we are going to make all nations bow the knee.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 8 A Star Called Wormwood

points: “Shew new signs, and make other strange wonders: glorify thy hand and thy right arm, that they may set forth thy wondrous works.” You see all the fires in Australia, things happening all across the earth: a billion animals got burnt up in Australia. What is happening on the earth? What is going on? “Raise up indignation, and pour out wrath:” That is what we are seeing happen, but because we have spiritual blindness on we don't correlate what we see on the news to the Bible prophecies. “take away the adversary, and destroy the enemy.”

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 8 A Star Called Wormwood

points: Make the time short: that is what we want right there. We often ask how long we are going to be in this captivity; Sirach said in the spirit, make the time short. Christ said the same thing in Matthew 24:22: except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved, but for the elect's sake, Israel, those days shall be shortened. And Paul said the time is short: they that have wives, be as though they had none, meaning put God first (1 Corinthians 7:29). Which would you rather have when the Lord returns: you out doing the work, or you huddled under your woman's skirt?

Some of us know and believe the end is coming; some of us are just hoping the end is coming; and some are just here in unbelief, abiding for a job or a spouse, whichever comes first, and then we will never see you again, and God won't see you any more either. Christ cut them sharp in John 6:26: ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled. Some of us listening, in here or online, are only following because there is some benefit you are looking for, food, a job or a spouse. Some people will only love you as much as they can use you; their loyalty ends where the benefits stop. Paul said for yet a little while, and he that shall come will come, and will not tarry; the just shall live by faith, but if any man draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him (Hebrews 10:37-39). You leave this truth, you have drawn back unto perdition, hell.
“remember the covenant, and let them declare thy wonderful works.” That is what we are doing: we are declaring the covenants and the wonderful works of the Most High God.
